children: Apple (AAPL) posted record June‑quarter revenue $109.4B. Greater China sales rose to $18.82B vs $15.37B year‑ago. iPhone, Mac and Services saw double‑digit revenue growth.
AAPL trades near 33x fiscal 2027 EPS, reflecting AI and hardware growth expectations. Analysts flag Services could slow and pressure the stock if earnings miss forecasts.
Apple (AAPL) unveiled M6 Mac mini claiming up to 4x faster AI, updated Mac Studio with M5 Max/M5 Ultra up to 512GB unified memory, and macOS 27 local Apple Intelligence/Siri AI features.
Apple (AAPL) launched Apple Intelligence across devices and services, focusing on on-device and integrated AI rather than heavy backend AI infrastructure investments.
Apple (AAPL) faces near-term margin pressure from rising memory costs; analysts expect gross margins to compress before recovering when memory supply eases and prices fall.
Apple (AAPL) demoed four Mac Studios running a trillion-parameter AI model to debug and fix a graphics coding glitch, showcasing local multi-device large-model inference on one outlet-powered setup.
AAPL raised iPhone 18 Pro prices: ~20%–23% (256GB) in Japan and India, ~8%–12% in China, UK, Germany, US, and ~5% in Australia.
Apple (AAPL) projected to reach ~10% India smartphone volume share in 2026, up from ~4% in 2022, driven by strong demand for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
AAPL launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable, plus iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max and iOS 27/macOS 27; Apple calls the Duo a new premium hardware category for its installed base.
Apple (AAPL) launched iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max: pre-orders Sept 12, in stores Sept 18 in 65+ regions. Pro models feature A20 Pro chip, 48MP variable-aperture camera, longer battery, Siri AI.
